source_instruction: i want large machine washable belaroi plus size tops for women.
query: I swear my cat has been on a total mischief spree all week, ever since I brought home that new fuzzy cat tree from the pet supply pop-up downtown. Yesterday I caught her dragging my favorite fuzzy crew sock all the way up the tallest perch like she was claiming it as her own personal trophy, and this morning she knocked over my full mug of iced oat milk latte right onto the stack of library books I had sitting on the coffee table. I spent twenty minutes blotting pages with paper towels and panicking I’d have to pay replacement fees, but the librarian just laughed when I brought them in and said they’ve seen way worse from pet-related mishaps. I even stopped on my way home to grab her a bag of those freeze-dried salmon treats she goes crazy for, like I’m rewarding her for being a little chaos gremlin, but I can’t even be mad when she curls up purring on my lap ten minutes after causing a mess. Hey, I’m browsing the women’s tops, tees & blouses section right now and need a little help picking something out. I want a large size for sure, and it has to be hand wash only, plus I’d really like it to come with a matching detachable fabric choker to switch up the look sometimes. Can you show me options that are a good price, nothing that feels overpriced for what it is? I don’t want to have to sift through stuff that doesn’t hit those marks, thanks.
